title: P52: present-but-empty consent roomId rejected
description: protocol-06 §5.7 ConsentEntry/ConsentScope roomId is optional<IdentifierUri> (P4/P6). Some(empty) would be a second, non-canonical way to say 'any room'; P12 (mimid-1wgh.5.27) applies only where roomId is not optional. Chosen: reject a present zero-length roomId on decode and encode.
